models.name: Arabic ASR (Vosk MGB2)
models.description: Egyptian Arabic speech recognition — REQUIRED model for the app to function. Also used for wake word detection via grammar constraint.
models.notes: Downloaded via Android DownloadManager from alphacephei.com. Recommend WiFi for download. Used for both ASR and wake word detection. P1 FIX: sha256 now filled and verified by ModelManager before extraction (mirror: https://github.com/waleedmandour/binti2/releases — verify same hash).

models.name: Neural Arabic TTS (Sherpa-ONNX VITS)
models.description: High-quality neural Arabic text-to-speech using sherpa-onnx with VITS/MMS model. 100% offline, significantly better voice quality than Android TTS. ~65 MB download. Recommended for best Egyptian Arabic voice experience.

training_info.dialect: Modern Standard Arabic (works well for Egyptian)

models.fallback: Android TTS or Huawei ML Kit TTS is used if this model is unavailable
models.notes: Sherpa-ONNX is a next-generation Kaldi project providing 100% offline neural TTS. The MMS (Massively Multilingual Speech) Arabic model produces natural-sounding Arabic speech. Download and select in Settings → TTS Engine. NOTE: The sherpa-onnx library JAR must be manually placed in app/libs/ — see docs/MODEL_SETUP_GUIDE.md.

models.name: Intent Pattern Map
models.description: JSON mapping of commands to intents (bundled in app assets)
models.notes: Included in app assets, no download needed. The rule-based intent classifier uses this file for weighted keyword matching.

optional_models.tts_sherpa_arabic: Neural Arabic TTS via Sherpa-ONNX (requires manual library setup)

removed_models.wake_word_tflite: Removed in v2.6.0-beta — wake word detection now uses Vosk grammar exclusively (WakeWordDetectorVosk). The TFLite-based WakeWordDetector.kt was deleted as dead code.
removed_models.nlu_classifier_onnx: Removed in v2.6.0-beta — intent classification is now purely rule-based (IntentClassifier.kt). The classifyWithML() and matchByFuzzy() stubs were removed; the ONNX Runtime Maven dependency was removed.

hosting.notes: The Vosk Arabic model is hosted on the official Vosk models page at alphacephei.com — the canonical source. ~318 MB.
